teaching_methods: Individual study time (reading notes, watching videos, solving problems)

assessment_methods.method: Class participation, seminars, and practical classes intervention

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, a minimum grade of 6/10 is required to liberate Exam Part I. To pass the course, a minimum grade of 4/10 must be obtained in each exam part (Part I and Part II). Completion of the process planning assignment and the programming practical is also mandatory. The final grade for passing the course must be a minimum of 5/10, calculated as the sum of grades from assignments, practical, exams, and class participation. For the extraordinary call, grades from the assignment, practical, and class participation are carried over. Students can take the full extraordinary exam or only the unliberated parts, with a minimum of 4/10 required in each exam part (I and II). The final grade for the extraordinary call is the maximum between the extraordinary exam grade (out of 10) and a weighted average of the extraordinary exam (80%), assignment (12.5%), practical (7.5%), plus class participation, with a minimum overall grade of 5/10 required to pass.
